name: focus-scheduler
title: Focus Scheduler
description: Schedule Raycast Focus sessions by weekday, time window, and categories.
author: Matheus

commands.name: manage-schedules
commands.title: Manage Focus Schedules
commands.description: View, edit, enable, or delete scheduled Focus sessions.

commands.name: create-schedule
commands.title: Create Focus Schedule
commands.description: Create a new Focus schedule with days, times, and categories.

commands.name: sync-focus-categories
commands.title: Sync Focus Categories
commands.description: Import your Raycast Focus Categories so they appear when creating schedules.

commands.name: check-schedules
commands.title: Check Focus Schedules
commands.description: Background checker that starts and completes Focus sessions on schedule.

preferences.name: categoriesExportPath
preferences.title: Categories Export File
preferences.description: Optional path to a Focus Categories JSON export. Categories from this file appear automatically in the schedule form.

echo "

If you wanted to publish to the Raycast Store, use \`npm run publish\` instead.
